product_family: Ada Assess (symptom assessment AI with medical guidance) and Medical Library. Consumer app and enterprise versions. Ada Assess is a Class IIa medical device under EU-MDR.

certifications.name: ISO 27001
certifications.proof_quote: Certified with the quality standard for information security

certifications.name: ISO 13485
certifications.proof_quote: Certified quality management system [for medical devices]

certifications.name: GDPR
certifications.proof_quote: Ada implements technical and organisational measures required by Article 32 GDPR and obtains ISO 27001 certification for its information security management system. Ada is EU-GDPR compliant.

certifications.name: EU-MDR
certifications.proof_quote: Ada Assess is classified as a Class IIa medical device according to regulation (EU) 2017/745

certifications.name: HIPAA
certifications.proof_quote: HIPAA Compliant badge displayed on enterprise health systems page. Company complies with HIPAA standards for US enterprise deployments.

certifications.name: SOC 2
certifications.proof_quote: No mention of SOC 2 certification found on ada.com security, privacy, or compliance pages despite detailed security documentation.

privacy.ai_training_note: Ada uses anonymized real world user data such as anonymized past assessment data for developing AI/LLM capabilities. Company follows high standards and strict procedures to ensure anonymization meets GDPR requirements.
privacy.data_region: EU (health data stored in EU on AWS EMEA S.A.R.L. in Luxembourg and Google Commerce Limited in Ireland)

security.name: Data separation
security.value: User details separated from health information, each stored separately in servers within the EU

security.name: Penetration testing
security.value: Regular penetration testing to identify vulnerabilities

security.name: Employee training
security.value: Employee security training through Global Compliance & Ethics Department

security.name: Audits
security.value: Both external and internal audits for regulatory compliance

security.name: Data residency
security.value: Health data always stays in EU; personal data processed by AWS EMEA and Google Ireland

security.name: Data Protection Officer
security.value: Designated DPO: dpo@ada.com; Supervisory authority: Berlin Data Protection Authority

products.name: Ada Assess (Consumer)
products.data_scope: User health data, symptoms, medical history
products.notes: Class I medical device. GDPR-compliant. Uses anonymized data for AI training with user consent. Free consumer application.

products.name: Ada Assess (Enterprise)
products.data_scope: Patient health data, EHR integration via FHIR
products.notes: Class IIa medical device under EU-MDR. Offered to health systems and life sciences. HIPAA-compliant deployment option available. Secure EHR/CRM integration.

products.name: Medical Library
products.data_scope: Health education content, no sensitive user data collection
products.notes: Educational resource. Grounded in latest medical research and peer-reviewed studies.

compare.pricing_model: Freemium consumer app; enterprise licensing for health systems and life sciences partners
compare.data_residency: EU-required (health data always in EU; AWS EMEA and Google Ireland)

flags: HIPAA certification is mentioned on enterprise pages (health systems, enterprise) but NOT on the main security page. Confidence is high that HIPAA-compliant versions exist for US enterprise deployments, but BAA documentation not found on ada.com; confirm BAA availability with sales team.
No evidence of SOC 2 Type 1 or Type 2 certification was found despite the vendor's detailed security disclosures. If SOC 2 is claimed elsewhere, verify it independently.
A GDPR data processing agreement is offered for enterprise customers; confirm the specific terms during procurement.
Medical device classification (EU-MDR Class IIa for Ada Assess) is a strength signal for clinical safety but may not apply to all product variants or use cases.
